meta.name: manage-mounts
meta.description: Configure which host directories agent containers can access. View, add, or remove mount allowlist entries. Triggers on "mounts", "mount allowlist", "agent access to directories", "container mounts".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 管理容器可访问的主机目录挂载
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要控制 agent 容器能访问哪些主机目录
copy.tagline_en: Manage which host directories agent containers can access
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to control which host directories agent containers can access

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能查看、添加或移除 NanoClaw agent 容器可访问的主机目录白名单,并显示每个目录是只读还是可读写。改动对新启动的容器自动生效,无需重启服务。
howto.when: 当你提到 “mounts”、“mount allowlist”、“container mounts” 等关键词,或要求调整 agent 可访问的主机目录时触发。

say.text: 看看现在的 mount allowlist 里允许哪些目录
say.note: 会按可读格式列出目录及其读写权限

say.text: 把 /data/projects 加进白名单,设为只读
say.note: 先校验路径存在,再写入配置

say.text: 把 /data/projects 从白名单里移除
say.note: 先展示现有条目,再写入精简后的配置

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude can view, add, or remove the NanoClaw agent container mount allowlist, showing each directory and whether it is read-only or read-write. Changes apply to newly spawned containers, no service restart needed.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention "mounts", "mount allowlist", "container mounts", etc., or ask to change which host directories agents can access.

say_en.text: Show which directories are in the mount allowlist
say_en.note: Lists directories and their read/write setting.

say_en.text: Add /data/projects to the allowlist as read-only
say_en.note: Validates the path, then writes the config.
Shows entries, then writes the trimmed config.
